Onboarding.step4Title: 4. Tip Tracking and Payouts from Dashboard

Settings.subtitle: Adjust your company details, integrate Stripe, and manage your QR locations.
Settings.logoFormats: Formats: PNG, JPG, or WEBP (Max 2 MB)
Settings.feeSubtitle: Define whether management and processing fees are covered by the business or added to the total paid by the customer.
Settings.feeMerchant: The Restaurant (Deducted from the total collected)
Settings.feeCustomer: The Customer (An extra €0.10 charge + processing fees are added at checkout)
Settings.stripeNotice: Stripe securely collects bank accounts; Propi never stores them.
Settings.nfcBoxTitle: Want to use NFC stickers or cards?
Settings.nfcBoxSubtitle: Set up your own NFC chips in less than 1 minute
Settings.nfcStep1Desc: Get neutral NFC stickers (NTAG213 or NTAG215). They cost less than €0.50 each on Amazon.
Settings.nfcStep2Desc: Download NFC Tools to encode your stickers easily.
Settings.nfcStep3Desc: 1. Copy the table's NFC URL. 2. Open NFC Tools → Write → Add record → URL. 3. Paste the URL and hold your phone close to the sticker.
